Two identical stairs: on S-04 they sit between grid 3 and T1 (3') and between T1 (5') and grid 6, rising from row A toward B.
The stair has no printed mark: element_id null, element_name_assigned 'บันได'. Stringer count is not printed (two drawn per flight); count left null.

Rise is printed '16 @ 0.1625 = 2.60' from ระดับพื้นชั้น 1 +0.50 to ระดับพื้นชั้นลอย +3.10 — those two levels and the rise chain are in the grid master. The plan's 0.50 / 0.50 / 0.90 and 1.00 / 2.75 chains carry no grid marker and stay on the element.
The stringer section prints '150x50x50x4.5' — four numbers that do not fit the channel order; only d/b parsed, print kept.
